changes.text: Fixed issue with minimap zoom while custom minimap texture.
Fixed issue with mouse going out of bounds while entering/leaving map component.

releases.title: UIV2 Reimagined, Custom Map and Settings Overhaul

changes.text: Redesigned Welcome Screen.
Redesigned UI Settings.
Redesigned Pause Menu.
Reworked grid and grid snapping behavior in Position Mode.
Slightly redesigned the Position Mode interface.
Decreased ZSX Multicharacter loading time through UIV2 Welcome Screen preloading.
Fixed an issue with queue mode for notifications.
Fixed an issue that caused the cursor to fly away while using the map.
Fixed an issue with displaying the map while the on-foot visibility option was enabled.
Fixed most issues related to Game Settings. Game Settings remain experimental.
Fixed an issue where the chat position was not saved in some cases.
Fixed chat suggestion parameters not being visible when the theme color was white.
Fixed selected chat input text not being visible when the theme color was white.
Fixed the fuel indicator icon not being visible when the theme color was white.
Fixed an issue where closed routes such as Pause Menu, UI Settings and Map could remain active on the front end.
Fixed Position Mode not displaying every HUD status.
Fixed notification in and out animations. They are now smooth again.
Fixed inconsistent minimap zoom.
Fixed HUD status in and out animations.
Fixed a potential framework detection issue.
Changed networking logic for chat messages.
Changed data traffic handling for music DUI metadata requests.
Applied a per-client rate limit for chat messages.
Applied game-view transitions.
Added a new minimap style. Players can now choose between the default minimap and the new style.
Added configurable minimap zoom.
Added a custom map to the P key.
Added Config.UseNativeMapOnPKey to control whether the native map is used on the P key.
Added an option to place and drag the HUD below the minimap.
Added automatic repositioning of default notifications and the street label when the HUD is placed below the minimap. The street label is repositioned when its on-foot visibility option is enabled.
Added an option to determine when the HUD should be animated.
Added a config option to switch between the custom map and native map in Pause Menu.
Added a configurable function for gathering the maximum weapon ammo.
Added an export for controlling the visibility of specific UI components, such as Displayers.
Added a custom map view that replaces the native GTA map.
Added an unlink feature for Chat, Displayers and HUD, allowing each interface to be moved separately.
Added 78 new configuration settings.
Added customization options for Chat, Displayers, Minimap, Street Label and Vehicle Indicators.
Added a Presets component for easy navigation through saved presets.
Added support for gathering server presets through UI Settings. The group or player requires the zsx.uiv2.preset_export ACE permission.
Added free positioning in Position Mode through the ALT key.
Added separate camera perspective settings for Pause Menu, UI Settings and Position Mode.
Updated the game-view renderer for Canary Beta FiveM clients.
Fixed TextUI onComplete events not being called due to the funcref.
Added background blur preset enabled by default.
Added storage verification to prevent issues with invalid storage data.
Created Context Menu that utilizes ox_lib features.
Created Vehicle Indicators that displays blinkers, emergency lights, engine & seatbelt status & more.
Created Plane Hud for better immersion.
Created Background Blur feature that allows you to make a glass effect on available components.
Created Widescreen compatibility.
Added Low Status Warnings that displays low indication values and sends default notification with a message.
Added day & night cycle for vehicle components to easily navigate through visible data.
Added Vertical Alignment option for hud.
Added vehicle mileage support.
Applied SetEntityInvincible native instead SetPlayerInvincible due to customer request.
Applied asynchronous loading for routes.
Applied different logic for timers for both Notifications and Default Notifications.
Applied listeners for vehicle types. When vehicle is electric it will display bolt icon instead of gas pump.
Applied different TextUI logic to handle key controls. Now it listens for any input, removes it from the Text and parses it to the key param.
Applied different handle for 3D Perspective content.
Slightly redesigned Car Hud metric units and progresses so they're more visible at night.
Small adjustments to the size of the 3D Perspective.
Seatbelt & Engine health icons have been moved to the vehicle indicator component.
Redesigned Postion and Preview mode. Now you're able to configure interface position way better.
Reworked Player DUI completely.
Optimized both of seatbelts and car hud threads, which results in really low usage while inside vehicle.
Optimized Points feature.
Optimized Player DUI.
Optimized 3D Perspective handle.
Fixed issues with NUI callbacks not returning any callback data.
Fixed issue with Default Car Hud type containg wrong position offsets.
Fixed issue with 3D Waypoints not being accessible while on foot.
Fixed issue with seatbelt indicator sounds being played twice in some cases.
Fixed issue with Square Hud type displaying zero values as full.
Added Config.UseVehicleRadioStations variable to handle whether radio stations should be enabled or not.
Added Config.UI.Use3DWaypoints variable to handle whether waypoints should be using 3D Points feature or not.
Added Config.PauseMenu.MapFrontendTiming table to handle in some extereme cases timings for minimap legend fix.
Fixed issue with minimap legend.
Removed 'calling minimap update' logs.
